### Blessings and Curses - Truth For Life - November 17
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-17-2024.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 28:2, 15
Points:
- Moses set before Israel the stark choice between covenant obedience leading to blessing and disobedience resulting in exile.
- Although the Israelites initially presumed they would never turn away, their rebellion eventually culminated in the tragic Babylonian captivity.
- Believers must recognize their constant vulnerability to temptation and not presume they are immune to drifting from God.
- Satan falsely portrays God’s commands as restrictive, whereas divine warnings and statutes are given for our true good and protection.
- Jesus endured the curse of human disobedience on the cross so that believers could share in the blessings He deserved.

### Bible Pathways 03/10/2002
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-10-or-2002-1127496.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 28:15
Points:
- Scripture devotes extensive space to the curses of disobedience to alert believers to the severity and certainty of divine judgment.
- The geographic confrontation between Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal illustrates the definitive spiritual choice between life and ruin.
- God's righteous warnings urge sinners to heed their conscience and turn to Christ in repentance while mercy remains available.
- Believers must recognize that true enjoyment of life is intimately bound to walking in obedience to God's Word.
